name: Slurm
description: Installs the distribution's Slurm and MUNGE and runs, at every container start, a real single-node Slurm cluster inside the dev container or only the client side against an external cluster, with the configuration directory persisted in a named volume.

apptainer.description: Configure Apptainer as the container backend of the local Slurm (srun --container, sbatch --container): auto when Apptainer and Slurm 23.02 or newer are in the image at build time, on to require them, off never.
